name: AI Security Institute (UK)
note: Founding network member; renamed from AI Safety Institute Feb 2025; network coordinator since Dec 2025. Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI), NIST
note: parent domain: nist.gov (no own domain; page nist.gov/caisi). Formerly US AI Safety Institute; renamed June 2025. Founding network member and inaugural chair (source: https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/11/fact-sheet-us-department-commerce-us-department-state-launch-international). Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: Canadian Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute (CAISI)
note: parent domain: ised-isde.canada.ca (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada). aisafety.ca is the CIFAR-run CAISI research program site, not the government institute itself. Founding member per https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/11/fact-sheet-us-department-commerce-us-department-state-launch-international. Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI)
note: Own domain. Hosted by IPA. Founding network member. Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: Korea AI Safety Institute (Korea AISI)
note: Own domain. Launched Nov 2024 within ETRI. Founding network member. name: Singapore AI Safety Institute
note: Own domain sgaisi.sg. The Digital Trust Centre at NTU (ntu.edu.sg) designated as Singapore AISI by IMDA (May 2024). Founding network member. Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: Institut national pour l'évaluation et la sécurité de l'intelligence artificielle (INESIA)
note: parent domain: entreprises.gouv.fr (DGE, Ministry of Economy; coordinated with SGDSN). No own domain found. Created 31 Jan 2025. France is a founding network member (source: https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/11/fact-sheet-us-department-commerce-us-department-state-launch-international). Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: European AI Office
note: parent domain: ec.europa.eu (European Commission, DG CNECT; page digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-office). EU founding network member represented by the AI Office. hq 'EU' is not an ISO country code (seat Brussels, BE). Network founded Nov 2024 as International Network of AI Safety Institutes; renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science (Dec 2025); membership re-confirmed in UK AISI blog (23 Jul 2026): https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/international-evaluation-best-practice-and-open-questions-in-ai-measurement

name: Australian AI Safety Institute
note: parent domain: industry.gov.au (Department of Industry, Science and Resources). note: parent domain: indiaai.gov.in (IndiaAI Mission, MeitY). Announced 30 Jan 2025. NOT a member of the international network as of Jul 2026; included as a government institute that presents as an AI safety institute.
